findingDetails.title: Acceptance row AC-013 names a verification command that cannot produce the evidence the row claims, and the row is marked Met
The findings registry that phase 014 D1 names was never updated to record the closures, so the record a follow-up review reads still shows every pre-014 finding active
The Chrome DevTools playbook recorded run is 4 PASS and 13 FAIL, and the failures are attributed to stale scenario text that was never corrected

results.summary: Six of the seven parent criteria hold on the tree; the seventh validate.sh --strict --recursive criterion is blocked for this lineage by the dispatch write limits
19 of 20 acceptance rows hold; AC-013 names a verification command that cannot produce its evidence
All three modes have a recorded run; the Chrome DevTools run is 4 PASS / 13 FAIL and the failing scenario text was not corrected

noveltyJustification: All three findings are new and none refines an earlier one: iterations 1 and 2 reviewed the advisor scorer and the install and capture scripts, this iteration reviewed the goal criteria and the acceptance rows, so weightedNew 3 of weightedTotal 3.
